selection_notes: Current versioned worktree files plus explicit reviewed new-public-source allowlist.

Excluded seven ancillary legacy files containing historical account paths; not needed by the Windows application build.
Fonts, SoundFonts, score fixtures, images, and the splash jingle are build/test resource data.
